fields.summary_ko.0: JPMorgan Chase (JPM) Q3 adjusted EPS of $5.75 missed consensus of $5.94, with net revenue of $50.17B below consensus of $52.21B.
fields.summary_ko.1: Driven by 49% surge in equity trading revenue ($4.95B) and 15% increase in investment banking revenue ($3.10B), while bond trading declined 4%.
fields.summary_ko.2: Net interest income grew 13% to $27.04B; average loans of $1.56 trillion and average deposits rose 8% to $2.73 trillion, expanding asset base.
